methodology: Fixed labeled relevance benchmark. Real records use verbatim title and abstract excerpts from arXiv metadata; synthetic records are hard negatives and are never production content.

records.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
records.abstractExcerpt: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve.

records.title: MC-EvoBench: Auditing Experience-Driven Self-Improvement in Minecraft Agents
records.abstractExcerpt: A central challenge in embodied recursive self-improvement is enabling agents to convert interaction history into capabilities that persist beyond one world and transfer to later tasks.

records.title: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare
records.abstractExcerpt: We present Cura 1T, a healthcare-specialized LLM built on the open-weight Kimi-K2.6 and trained through a human-gated recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop.

records.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
records.abstractExcerpt: These results show that foundation world models can serve both as embodied world models and scalable data engines for embodied intelligence.

records.title: Towards Resiliency in Large Language Model Serving with KevlarFlow
records.abstractExcerpt: KevlarFlow leverages decoupled model parallelism initialization, dynamic traffic rerouting, and background KV cache replication to maintain high throughput during partial failures.

records.title: Accelerating Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Serving with Speculation
records.abstractExcerpt: We propose RaLMSpec, a speculation-inspired framework that provides generic speed-up over iterative RaLM while preserving the same model outputs through speculative retrieval and batched verification.

records.title: RSI Signals for Short-Horizon Equity Trading
records.abstractExcerpt: We study the relative strength index (RSI) as a technical indicator for stock-market momentum.

records.title: Workplace Interventions for RSI
records.abstractExcerpt: This clinical survey examines repetitive strain injury among office workers.

records.title: A Model for Image Classification
records.abstractExcerpt: A neural model learns labels from a static supervised dataset.

records.title: Reinforcement Learning for Cart Pole
records.abstractExcerpt: A standard policy learns to balance a pole in a fixed benchmark without adaptation or systems contributions.
